sections.title: Habitats
lines: Desert and caravan routes

sections.title: Appearance
lines: A single-humped camel with wide padded feet and a rolling gait.

sections.title: Special attacks mechanics
lines: Spitting · An ill-tempered camel has a 50% chance to spit at someone who tries to ride it or use it as a pack animal. The victim then has a 25% chance of being blinded for 1–3 rounds.

Herd stampede · A frightened herd has a 25% chance of stampeding. Roll 2d4 camels for each creature in its path that fails to take cover. Each camel deals 1–4 damage to that creature. Trampled creatures stay down until the herd passes.

sections.title: Handling mechanics
lines: Carrying capacity · Load by weight in gold pieces: 250 normal, 400 encumbered, 520 fully encumbered. Camels kneel to be loaded and often refuse to rise with more than their encumbered load.
Desert camel use · A steady mount and pack animal that carries heavy loads across difficult terrain.

sections.title: Table notes
lines: 1–12 appearing. Steady (12) morale. Animal to semi-intelligent (1–4).

Herd stampede · A frightened herd has a 25% chance of stampeding. Roll 2d4 camels for each creature in its path that fails to take cover. Each camel deals 1–4 damage to that creature. Trampled creatures stay down until the herd passes.
Bite and hooves · The war camel bites for 1d4 and attacks twice with its hooves for 1d6 each. A successful hoof attack keeps the opponent prone.
